title: Ingvar the Plunderer
content: Ingvar the Plunderer is the final boss of Utgarde Keep, a level 69 to 72 five-player dungeon in Howling Fjord. He is resurrected once by a val'kyr after the first kill, so the fight is effectively two rounds.

title: Prince Keleseth
content: Prince Keleseth is the first boss of Utgarde Keep, a level 69 to 72 five-player dungeon in Howling Fjord. He freezes a player in an ice tomb that the rest of the group has to break.

title: Keristrasza
content: Keristrasza is the final boss of The Nexus, a level 71 to 73 five-player dungeon in Coldarra, in the Borean Tundra. She applies a stacking chill that forces the group to keep moving for the whole fight.

title: Grand Magus Telestra
content: Grand Magus Telestra is a boss of The Nexus, a level 71 to 73 five-player dungeon in Coldarra, in the Borean Tundra. She splits into three copies partway through, each with a different school of magic.

title: Anub'arak
content: Anub'arak is the final boss of Azjol-Nerub, a level 72 to 74 five-player dungeon in Dragonblight. He is the last nerubian king, raised by the Scourge; he also appears as the final encounter of Trial of the Crusader.

title: Hadronox
content: Hadronox is the second boss of Azjol-Nerub, a level 72 to 74 five-player dungeon in Dragonblight. The fight is a fighting retreat up a web tunnel while she drags the party's own pursuers into it.

title: Krik'thir the Gatewatcher
content: Krik'thir the Gatewatcher is the first boss of Azjol-Nerub, a level 72 to 74 five-player dungeon in Dragonblight. He is guarded by three named watchers that can be pulled with him.

title: Herald Volazj
content: Herald Volazj is the final boss of Ahn'kahet: The Old Kingdom, a level 73 to 75 five-player dungeon in Dragonblight. He casts an insanity effect that puts each player in a private phase fighting shadow copies of the group.

title: Prince Taldaram
content: Prince Taldaram is a boss of Ahn'kahet: The Old Kingdom, a level 73 to 75 five-player dungeon in Dragonblight. He is a san'layn vampire who vanishes and embraces a player for heavy damage until two nearby orbs are clicked.

title: Elder Nadox
content: Elder Nadox is the first boss of Ahn'kahet: The Old Kingdom, a level 73 to 75 five-player dungeon in Dragonblight. He summons swarms of adds, and one guardian must be killed fast or he becomes immune.

title: King Dred
content: King Dred is the final boss of Drak'Tharon Keep, a level 74 to 76 five-player dungeon in on the border between the Grizzly Hills and Zul'Drak. He is a devilsaur kept by the Drakkari, and the raptors around him can be pulled in with the fight.

title: Novos the Summoner
content: Novos the Summoner is the second boss of Drak'Tharon Keep, a level 74 to 76 five-player dungeon in on the border between the Grizzly Hills and Zul'Drak. He is untouchable until four channelling crystals around the platform are destroyed.

title: Cyanigosa
content: Cyanigosa is the final boss of Violet Hold, a level 75 to 77 five-player dungeon in Dalaran. She arrives after the timed prison waves are survived, and is always the last encounter regardless of which mini-bosses spawned.

title: Gal'darah
content: Gal'darah is the final boss of Gundrak, a level 76 to 78 five-player dungeon in Zul'Drak. He shifts between troll and rhino form, impaling players in one and goring in the other.

title: Moorabi
content: Moorabi is a boss of Gundrak, a level 76 to 78 five-player dungeon in Zul'Drak. He tries to transform into a mammoth, which has to be interrupted or the fight gets much harder.

title: Sjonnir The Ironshaper
content: Sjonnir The Ironshaper is the final boss of Halls of Stone, a level 77 to 79 five-player dungeon in The Storm Peaks. He is reached after the Tribunal of Ages escort, and floods the room with iron and earthen adds.

title: Maiden of Grief
content: Maiden of Grief is a boss of Halls of Stone, a level 77 to 79 five-player dungeon in The Storm Peaks. She drops shadow pools that have to be moved out of quickly.

title: Loken
content: Loken is the final boss of Halls of Lightning, a level 79 to 80 five-player dungeon in The Storm Peaks. The fight is a damage race against Lightning Nova and a pulse that hits harder the further away you stand.

title: General Bjarngrim
content: General Bjarngrim is the first boss of Halls of Lightning, a level 79 to 80 five-player dungeon in The Storm Peaks. He patrols with an escort and cycles through three combat stances.

title: King Ymiron
content: King Ymiron is the final boss of Utgarde Pinnacle, a level 79 to 80 five-player dungeon in Howling Fjord. He is the vrykul king, and he channels power from the burial barrows around the room.

title: Skadi the Ruthless
content: Skadi the Ruthless is a boss of Utgarde Pinnacle, a level 79 to 80 five-player dungeon in Howling Fjord. The first half is fought from a drake, throwing harpoons at his mount before he lands.

title: Svala Sorrowgrave
content: Svala Sorrowgrave is the first boss of Utgarde Pinnacle, a level 79 to 80 five-player dungeon in Howling Fjord. She sacrifices a player on an altar partway through and must be interrupted or healed past it.

title: Ley-Guardian Eregos
content: Ley-Guardian Eregos is the final boss of The Oculus, a level 79 to 80 five-player dungeon in Coldarra, in the Borean Tundra. He is fought entirely from drake mounts, which is why the dungeon has the reputation it does.

title: Mal'Ganis
content: Mal'Ganis is the final boss of The Culling of Stratholme, a level 79 to 80 five-player dungeon in the Caverns of Time in Tanaris. He is the dreadlord who baits Arthas into the purge, and he escapes rather than dying.

title: Chrono-Lord Epoch
content: Chrono-Lord Epoch is a boss of The Culling of Stratholme, a level 79 to 80 five-player dungeon in the Caverns of Time in Tanaris. He is an infinite dragonflight agent trying to stop the purge from happening as it should.

title: The Black Knight
content: The Black Knight is the final boss of Trial of the Champion, a level 79 to 80 five-player dungeon in the Argent Tournament grounds in Icecrown. He rises twice after being killed, first as a skeleton and then as a ghost.

title: Devourer of Souls
content: Devourer of Souls is the final boss of The Forge of Souls, a level 79 to 80 five-player dungeon in Icecrown Citadel. It is a three-faced construct that alternates a mirrored fear with a wailing beam.

title: Bronjahm
content: Bronjahm is the first boss of The Forge of Souls, a level 79 to 80 five-player dungeon in Icecrown Citadel. He is the Godfather of Souls, and at thirty percent health he stops and channels while soul fragments close on him.

title: Scourgelord Tyrannus
content: Scourgelord Tyrannus is the final boss of Pit of Saron, a level 79 to 80 five-player dungeon in Icecrown Citadel. He is fought at the end of the scripted escape, after his frost wyrm Rimefang harries the group up the ramp.

title: Forgemaster Garfrost
content: Forgemaster Garfrost is the first boss of Pit of Saron, a level 79 to 80 five-player dungeon in Icecrown Citadel. He forges a weapon mid-fight, changing his abilities each time he picks a new one up.

title: Falric
content: Falric is the first boss of Halls of Reflection, a level 79 to 80 five-player dungeon in Icecrown Citadel. He appears after a set of scripted waves, and applies a stacking fear that grows through the fight.

title: Marwyn
content: Marwyn is the second boss of Halls of Reflection, a level 79 to 80 five-player dungeon in Icecrown Citadel. He is the second of the two captains fought before the Lich King chase begins.

title: Kel'Thuzad
content: Kel'Thuzad is the final boss of Naxxramas, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in Dragonblight. He is the lich who founded the Scourge's Cult of the Damned, fought at the top of the necropolis after Sapphiron.

title: Sapphiron
content: Sapphiron is the boss before Kel'Thuzad of Naxxramas, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in Dragonblight. A frost wyrm fought in an ice-covered room where players hide behind ice blocks to survive its breath.

title: Patchwerk
content: Patchwerk is a boss of Naxxramas, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in Dragonblight. A pure damage-and-healing check with no mechanics to speak of, long used as a benchmark fight.

title: Thaddius
content: Thaddius is a boss of Naxxramas, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in Dragonblight. Players are given positive or negative charges and have to split by sign or take heavy raid damage.

title: Heigan the Unclean
content: Heigan the Unclean is a boss of Naxxramas, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in Dragonblight. Known for its dance: the floor erupts in a repeating pattern the whole raid has to keep ahead of.

title: Loatheb
content: Loatheb is a boss of Naxxramas, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in Dragonblight. Healing is blocked except in brief windows, so healers rotate through a fixed order.

title: Instructor Razuvious
content: Instructor Razuvious is a boss of Naxxramas, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in Dragonblight. He is tanked by mind-controlled understudies rather than by a player.

title: Maexxna
content: Maexxna is a boss of Naxxramas, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in Dragonblight. She webs players to the wall, and the rest of the raid has to free them.

title: Anub'Rekhan
content: Anub'Rekhan is the first boss of the Arachnid Quarter of Naxxramas, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in Dragonblight. He is a nerubian crypt lord who summons corpse scarabs while chasing a random player.

title: Sartharion
content: Sartharion is the final boss of The Obsidian Sanctum, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in the Chamber of Aspects beneath Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight. Leaving his three drakes alive when he is pulled raises the difficulty and the reward.

title: Malygos
content: Malygos is the final boss of The Eye of Eternity, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in Coldarra, in the Borean Tundra. The Aspect of Magic, and the fight ends with the whole raid on drakes in a vehicle phase.

title: Yogg-Saron
content: Yogg-Saron is the final boss of Ulduar, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in The Storm Peaks. An Old God fought in three phases, including a stretch inside visions of the past; leaving fewer of Sara's keepers active makes it much harder.

title: Flame Leviathan
content: Flame Leviathan is the first boss of Ulduar, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in The Storm Peaks. The entire fight is fought from siege vehicles rather than on foot.

title: Mimiron
content: Mimiron is a boss of Ulduar, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in The Storm Peaks. A four-phase mechanical fight, and its hard mode sets the room on fire for the duration.

title: Thorim
content: Thorim is a boss of Ulduar, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in The Storm Peaks. The raid splits in two, one group through an arena gauntlet and one up a corridor, meeting at the top.

title: Freya
content: Freya is a boss of Ulduar, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in The Storm Peaks. Her hard mode is set by leaving up to three elders alive when she is pulled.

title: Kologarn
content: Kologarn is a boss of Ulduar, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in The Storm Peaks. A giant built into the wall, whose two arms are killed separately and regrow.

title: XT-002 Deconstructor
content: XT-002 Deconstructor is a boss of Ulduar, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in The Storm Peaks. Its heart is exposed periodically, and attacking it there is what triggers the hard mode.

title: Algalon the Observer
content: Algalon the Observer is a bonus boss of Ulduar, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in The Storm Peaks. A limited-attempt encounter behind a hard-mode gate, added as the expansion's most exclusive kill at the time.

title: General Vezax
content: General Vezax is the boss before Yogg-Saron of Ulduar, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in The Storm Peaks. Mana regeneration is shut off for the fight, so casters draw from saronite vapours instead.

title: Lord Jaraxxus
content: Lord Jaraxxus is a boss of Trial of the Crusader, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in the Argent Tournament grounds in Icecrown. An eredar lord accidentally summoned into the arena partway through the event.

title: The Lich King
content: The Lich King is the final boss of Icecrown Citadel, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in Icecrown. Arthas Menethil, fought on the roof of the Frozen Throne; it is the last encounter of Wrath of the Lich King. He also appears unkillable at the end of Halls of Reflection.

title: Sindragosa
content: Sindragosa is the boss before the Lich King of Icecrown Citadel, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in Icecrown. Sapphiron's risen mate, who stacks a frost debuff that forces players to hide behind ice tombs.

title: Professor Putricide
content: Professor Putricide is a boss of Icecrown Citadel, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in Icecrown. The end of the plague wing, fought around slime pools he brews mid-fight.

title: Lord Marrowgar
content: Lord Marrowgar is the first boss of Icecrown Citadel, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in Icecrown. He impales players on bone spikes and whirlwinds across the room.

title: Deathbringer Saurfang
content: Deathbringer Saurfang is a boss of Icecrown Citadel, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in Icecrown. He gains power from blood drawn off the raid, so damage taken is what fuels him.

title: Lady Deathwhisper
content: Lady Deathwhisper is the second boss of Icecrown Citadel, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in Icecrown. She is shielded by mana until it is burned through, and raises adds from the cultists around her.

title: Blood-Queen Lana'thel
content: Blood-Queen Lana'thel is a boss of Icecrown Citadel, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in Icecrown. She bites a player who must pass the bite on before a timer, spreading it through the raid.

title: Halion
content: Halion is the final boss of The Ruby Sanctum, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in the Chamber of Aspects beneath Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight. He is fought in a physical and a shadow version of the same room at once, with the raid split between them.

title: Archavon the Stone Watcher
content: Archavon the Stone Watcher is the first boss of Vault of Archavon, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in Wintergrasp. He is only reachable by the faction that currently holds Wintergrasp.

title: Onyxia
content: Onyxia is the only boss of Onyxia's Lair, a level 80 ten- and twenty-five-player raid in Dustwallow Marsh. A black dragon fought in ground and air phases; retuned from level 60 to level 80 in patch 3.2.2.

title: Ragnaros
content: Ragnaros is the final boss of Molten Core, a level 60 to 63 forty-player raid in Blackrock Mountain. A firelord summoned by the Dark Iron dwarves, and the game's first raid-ending boss.

title: Nefarian
content: Nefarian is the final boss of Blackwing Lair, a level 60 to 63 forty-player raid in Blackrock Mountain. Deathwing's son, who calls out class-wide effects by name during the fight.

title: Hakkar
content: Hakkar is the final boss of Zul'Gurub, a level 57 to 63 twenty-player raid in Stranglethorn Vale. The blood god of the Gurubashi trolls, weakened by killing his high priests first.

title: C'Thun
content: C'Thun is the final boss of Ahn'Qiraj Temple, a level 60 to 63 forty-player raid in Silithus. An Old God fought partly from inside its own stomach.

title: Edwin VanCleef
content: Edwin VanCleef is the final boss of Deadmines, a level 17 to 20 five-player dungeon in Westfall. The leader of the Defias Brotherhood, fought on the deck of a ship inside the mine.

title: Archmage Arugal
content: Archmage Arugal is the final boss of Shadowfang Keep, a level 18 to 21 five-player dungeon in Silverpine Forest. The renegade mage who created the worgen infesting the keep.

title: Baron Rivendare
content: Baron Rivendare is the final boss of the undead side of Stratholme, a level 58 to 60 five-player dungeon in the Eastern Plaguelands. He drops the Deathcharger's Reins, and a timed run of his wing rewards extra loot.

title: Darkmaster Gandling
content: Darkmaster Gandling is the final boss of Scholomance, a level 58 to 60 five-player dungeon in the Western Plaguelands. The headmaster of the necromancy school, who teleports players into side rooms during the fight.

title: Emperor Dagran Thaurissan
content: Emperor Dagran Thaurissan is the final boss of Blackrock Depths, a level 49 to 56 five-player dungeon in Blackrock Mountain. The Dark Iron emperor, fought beside his wife Moira, who must be left alive.

title: Illidan Stormrage
content: Illidan Stormrage is the final boss of Black Temple, a level 70 twenty-five-player raid in Shadowmoon Valley. The Betrayer, and the intended final boss of the Burning Crusade before the Sunwell was added.

title: Kael'thas Sunstrider
content: Kael'thas Sunstrider is the final boss of Tempest Keep, a level 70 twenty-five-player raid in Netherstorm. The blood elf prince, fought in a long multi-phase encounter; a weakened version of him is also the final boss of Magister's Terrace.

title: Lady Vashj
content: Lady Vashj is the final boss of Coilfang: Serpentshrine Cavern, a level 70 twenty-five-player raid in Zangarmarsh. A naga sea witch whose middle phase requires relaying tainted cores to break her shield.

title: Kil'jaeden
content: Kil'jaeden is the final boss of The Sunwell, a level 70 twenty-five-player raid in the Isle of Quel'Danas. The Burning Legion's second-in-command, and the last boss of the Burning Crusade.

title: Archimonde
content: Archimonde is the final boss of The Battle for Mount Hyjal, a level 70 twenty-five-player raid in the Caverns of Time in Tanaris. Fought at the World Tree, where players use tears of the goddess to survive his air burst.

title: Prince Malchezaar
content: Prince Malchezaar is the final boss of Karazhan, a level 70 to 73 ten-player raid in Deadwind Pass. A eredar prince at the top of the tower, who rains infernals into the room.

title: Gruul the Dragonkiller
content: Gruul the Dragonkiller is the final boss of Gruul's Lair, a level 70 twenty-five-player raid in Blade's Edge Mountains. He grows larger and hits harder on a timer, so the raid spreads out to avoid shatter damage.

title: Magtheridon
content: Magtheridon is the only boss of Magtheridon's Lair, a level 70 twenty-five-player raid in Hellfire Peninsula. A pit lord held in place by five channelers who must be killed together.

title: Zul'jin
content: Zul'jin is the final boss of Zul'Aman, a level 70 to 73 ten-player raid in the Ghostlands. The Amani warlord, who cycles through animal-god forms as his health drops.

title: Mekgineer Thermaplugg
content: Mekgineer Thermaplugg is the final boss of Gnomeregan, a level 25 to 28 five-player dungeon in Dun Morogh. He is fought around a room of bomb-dispensing panels that have to be closed.

title: Archaedas
content: Archaedas is the final boss of Uldaman, a level 37 to 40 five-player dungeon in the Badlands. A titan construct who animates the statues lining the room as adds.

title: Murmur
content: Murmur is the final boss of Auchindoun: Shadow Labyrinth, a level 69 to 70 five-player dungeon in Terokkar Forest. A sound elemental with a room-wide pull followed by a detonation players must run out of.

title: Chief Ukorz Sandscalp
content: Chief Ukorz Sandscalp is the final boss of Zul'Farrak, a level 43 to 46 five-player dungeon in Tanaris. The Sandfury chief, reached after the pyramid steps event.

title: Princess Theradras
content: Princess Theradras is the final boss of Maraudon, a level 41 to 48 five-player dungeon in Desolace. An earth elemental princess at the bottom of the pristine waters wing.

title: King Gordok
content: King Gordok is the final boss of the north wing of Dire Maul, a level 55 to 60 five-player dungeon in Feralas. Killing him grants the ogre suit tribute run, which is why players clear the wing carefully.

title: General Drakkisath
content: General Drakkisath is the final boss of the upper wing of Blackrock Spire, a level 57 to 63 five- and ten-player dungeon in Blackrock Mountain. He guards the orb used for the old Onyxia attunement chain.

title: Mutanus the Devourer
content: Mutanus the Devourer is the final boss of Wailing Caverns, a level 17 to 20 five-player dungeon in the Barrens. He appears at the end of the escort event that the whole dungeon leads up to.

title: Amnennar the Coldbringer
content: Amnennar the Coldbringer is the final boss of Razorfen Downs, a level 34 to 37 five-player dungeon in the Southern Barrens. A lich raising the quilboar dead, and the highest-level threat in the warrens.

title: Herod
content: Herod is the final boss of the Armory wing of Scarlet Monastery, a level 29 to 40 five-player dungeon in Tirisfal Glades. The Scarlet champion, who whirlwinds across the room and then flees to pull the training hall.

title: High Inquisitor Whitemane
content: High Inquisitor Whitemane is the final boss of the Cathedral wing of Scarlet Monastery, a level 29 to 40 five-player dungeon in Tirisfal Glades. She resurrects Scarlet Commander Mograine once, so both have to be brought down together.
